Lemma
[Convergence of DeTurck diffeomorphisms (Lemma 35.28)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0318 1. ch35:35.28\group Dynamic Stability

If a time-dependent vector field satisfies $\sup _x|W(x,t)|_{g(t)}\le Ce^{-ct}$, then its generated diffeomorphisms converge exponentially to a limiting diffeomorphism.
